{{Quote|Wish I knew where the Vornells ended up. Their crops are going sour.''"<br />"''It's not like them to leave credits on the table.|Two Kessan's Landing farmers|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
The '''Vornell''' family was a family of [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] who resided on [[Kessan's Landing]], on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], during the [[Third Galactic War]]. The Vornells disappeared<ref name="TOR" /> around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref> likely captured by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the  [[Hidden Chain]] during their [[raid on Kessan's Landing]].<ref name="TOR"/>
